'''Rare Book Collection''' is a [[special]] [[condition]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

It can only be put into play by an [[encounter]] at the [[Library]] (or [[Hall School]] if the [[Kingsport Horror]] and [[Miskatonic Horror]] [[expansion]]s are being employed as well).

==Card info==
'''Condition''': The Library has the following special ability:

'''Rare Book Collection''':  Instead of having an encounter here, you may lose 1 [[Sanity]] to gain 1 [[Clue token]].
